Review Linktree?

Reviewers mostly see Linktree as a fast, reliable way to put multiple links in one clean bio page, especially for social platforms with a single-link limit. They repeatedly praise the easy setup, simple customization, mobile-friendly layout, and basic analytics. The main drawbacks are also consistent: stronger branding, deeper insights, and more flexibility often require a paid plan, and some users find the design restrictive. One maker of Kasbu.bio argues its vertical list format feels limiting, while a few users also report billing and cancellation frustration.

Linktree is a simple yet powerful tool for managing multiple links in one place, making it perfect for social media bios. It’s especially useful for Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms that only allow a single bio link. I love how easy it is to set up and customize, allowing users to add links, social media buttons, and even embed videos. The analytics feature is great for tracking clicks and engagement. While the free version covers the basics, the Pro plan unlocks more customization and deeper insights. Overall, it’s a must-have for creators, businesses, and anyone looking to optimize their online presence.
